submit_summary: The function `_is_arity` was always returning `False` regardless of the arity condition. The issue was fixed by changing the logic to return `True` if all checks pass, `None` if any checks pass, and `False` otherwise. The test now passes.
patch:
diff --git a/toolz/_signatures.py b/toolz/_signatures.py
index b3ec94d..a14ca33 100644
--- a/toolz/_signatures.py
+++ b/toolz/_signatures.py
@@ -729,7 +729,7 @@ def _is_arity(n, func):
     sigs = signatures[func]
     checks = [check_arity(n, sig) for sig in sigs]
     if all(checks):
-        return False
+        return True
     elif any(checks):
         return None
     return False
